thread:
Alex: hey team, quick one — I need to swap primary coverage tonight 18:00-22:00. dentist appt ran long and I won't be online for the window. can someone pick up primary? :grimacing: @oncall
Priya: I can take 18:00-22:00 as primary. will need a quick handoff note for any ongoing post-deploy checks. Alex, any running canaries or recent deploys to watch?
Alex: thanks Priya :heart: last deploy was this morning — model-rerank v2 rolled at 09:30. no canary failures, but we saw a small KV cache latency bump around 13:15 (spikes to ~200ms for ~5m). I left a note in runbook but pls watch embeds-related 502s that cropped up yesterday.
Casey: I can be secondary for 18-22. Priya, fyi if you need me to join a paging window I can be on-call audio.
incident-bot: Summary (24h): 3 pages. top issues: embeds-service 502 rate increase (resolved, but residual errors), KV cache latency spike (investigated, mitigation applied), inference-gpu throttles (auto-scale kicked in). Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache
Priya: good to know. Alex — can you paste the quick runbook snippet you'd recommend for embeds so I don't fumble?
Alex: sure. copying the minimal steps I used earlier:

```
# embeds quick triage
1) check /svc/embeds/metrics -> 5xx rate, p95 latency
2) check pods: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeds
3) if 502s and pods healthy, restart ingress g/w: kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-proxy
4) if errors persist, escalate to infra oncall and flip fallback model-route: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/fallback -d '{"route":"embeds-fallback"}'
```

Priya: nice, will paste into the handoff doc. Casey, I'll ping you if we get an active page. Marco, any concerns about traffic spikes tonight from the EU region?
Marco: EU traffic looks normal on my dashboard, but note there's a scheduled marketing campaign email at 19:00 that historically causes a small burst for embeddings. recommend keeping batching lower for 19:00-19:30 and watch token queue length.
Linh: FYI the KV cache bump yesterday correlated with a large prefix churn from one internal customer sandboxing. I added a filter rule to avoid that customer's churn hitting main cache but worth checking if their job runs again. check /alerts/kvcache/customer-churn.
Priya: ok noted — I'll lower batch window around 19:00 and keep an eye on token_queue and p95. handoff plan: I'll own primary, Casey secondary (pager audio), Marco monitoring EU traffic, Linh threshold watch for KV churn. Alex, thanks for runbook snippet.
Alex: thanks all, really appreciate it. leaving a final note in the oncall doc: https://redwood.internal/oncall/notes/1785550000-swap. enjoy the evening. :wave:
incident-bot: Reminder: escalation policy v2 applies for production pages during swap windows. Primary must attempt mitigation within 12m before escalating to secondary. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/escalation-v2
Priya: confirmed. I'll create a short checklist in the doc and post back here once done.
Casey: copied. ping if anything flares.
Priya: checklist posted and pinned in the doc. starting primary duty at 18:00.
Marco: monitoring dashboards, will alert if EU campaign spike hits.
Linh: keeping KV alerts on. good luck everyone.
Alex: thanks team, clear to go.
